audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and content.mid say Purgatory 'can execute you through the Pop Blossom channel'. The kit supports a different and more actionable interaction: Purgatory carries the grounding flag, and Pop Blossom is Neeko's only dash. Grounding denies the leap itself.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags dash-denied for exactly this pair. 'It executes through your channel' tells a player to fear the damage; 'it grounds you so the leap never happens' tells them what actually goes wrong and when. The execute is real too — Riot's text says the artifact potentially executes enemies hit — but the denial is what kills the ult.
audit.corrected: whys[4], content.mid and wants.foe[0] now state the grounding and the 120s clock.
sources: kit: Locke R grounding and execute flags, cd 120/100/80

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t says 'Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.'
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal here. Soul Ignition heals back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect, on an 18s cooldown at rank 1 — that is healing, and Grievous Wounds cuts it whatever its source. Calling it optional talks the player out of the item that decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now recommends Grievous Wounds and names the ability it cuts.
sources: kit: Locke W text, heal flag, cd 18/17/16/15/14

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Locke's Q 'Ritual Nails' in fourteen fields. Riot's text in the kit file reads 'Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw', and the other three named abilities in missingInteractions are Silver Stake (P), Soul Ignition (W), Ashen Pursuit (E) and Purgatory (R) — no Ritual Nails anywhere.
audit.why: This looks like the Brand 'Ares of Blaze' class of error, but the packet's enemyAbilities is null for Locke, so I have no authoritative name list to confirm 'Soul Nails' is the ability's title rather than the projectile's. I did not rename it on a guess — a wrong correction is worse than the flagged original.
audit.corrected: Not changed. Raised in questionsForUser; it is champion-wide, not per-matchup.

notes: No mirror existed for this pair (locke__neeko not on disk), so nothing here was constrained by an opposing page — the chart matches the packet already and I left it alone. Two flagged interactions I could not place in a length-safe field: Ashen Pursuit (E) is an auto-attack reset, so the burst tell is the early attack rather than a cast, and Silver Stake (P) applies on-hit magic damage scaled by missing health, which means armour alone misreads the trade. Also note the kit's resistances-invalidated flag points at Soul Ignition's trueDamage, but Riot's text says that damage is dealt to Locke himself — the flag appears to be a tooltip-parsing misfire and I did not write it into the page.
